title: Shadows of Old Salt Lake Walking Tour
includes: Q&A with Your Guide – ask about ghosts, history, or your own spooky experiences
Fun for All Paranormal Enthusiasts – whether you’re a believer, skeptic, or just love weird history
Photo Opportunities at some of Salt Lake City’s most atmospheric and haunted buildings
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Uncover the chilling tales of Salt Lake City on this captivating walking tour that delves into the city’s eerie past. Navigate the dark, narrow streets of downtown and discover the hidden stories behind its oldest buildings and landmarks. From haunted hotels to unsolved mysteries, this tour promises an exploration of the strange and unusual. Perfect for history buffs and thrill-seekers alike, each stop reveals the haunting echoes of a bygone era.

- Experience Salt Lake City’s haunted history on a guided walking tour
- Explore tales of ghostly encounters and unsolved mysteries
- Visit iconic landmarks and forgotten corners of downtown
- Ideal for history enthusiasts and those seeking a unique adventure
